$meta.name: Dahab Focal design tokens
$meta.statusNote: The Claude Design project could not be read this session — the design MCP was not authorised. Only values that are provably stated in the brief are real here; everything marked provisional is a magenta sentinel, chosen so a missed token is impossible to look at without noticing. See docs/FOUNDATION.md.

contrast.note: Measured in the design and asserted here, never recomputed-and-accepted. A palette edit that breaks one of these fails the build.

forbidden.reason: Coral is a fill, never text. Coral text on light is coral-700.
The primary CTA label is abyss-900. Where a white label is required, the fill is coral-800.
sand-400 is a border colour. Muted text is sand-500.

coral-500.note: Stated in the brief. Confirmed: white on this is 2.7992, which is the 2.80 the brief reports. Fill only, never text.

coral-800.note: The fill used when a white label is required.

abyss-900.note: Primary ink, and the primary CTA label on coral-500.

lagoon-500.note: Focus ring: 2px at 2px offset, drawn as the brand's camera-focus ring.

ink.note: Stated in the brief. Confirmed: 15.934 on surface, which is the 15.9 the brief reports.

gradient.$note: Every named gradient with its stops and angle comes from the design file. None could be read this session.

type.$note: Family, weight, size, line-height and letter-spacing per role, from the design file. None could be read this session.

ui.note: Named in the brief. Must ship latin, latin-ext, cyrillic and arabic subsets.

mono.note: Named in the brief. Tabular figures and ids.

radius.$note: From the design file. Not read this session.

space.$note: The spacing scale, from the design file. Not read this session.

shadow.$note: Warm-tinted, never neutral grey. Definitions from the design file. Not read this session.

motion.$note: Named curves and durations from the design file. Not read this session.

icon.$note: The icon list from the design file. Not read this session.

noFlip.$note: Icons that must not mirror in RTL: physical objects, brand marks and media transport controls. The list is design-driven, but the rule is not.
